name: Hardware-Aware Hyperparameter Tuning
definition: An automatic process to determine optimal hyperparameters (tile size, unroll factor, number of bins, batch divisor) for a given scene and hardware, ensuring correctness and performance without manual tuning.
summary: Hardware-Aware Hyperparameter Tuning automatically optimizes shader batch sizes and bin layouts for specific hardware, distinguishing itself by focusing on compile-time configuration rather than geometric traversal.
